craft_notes: Sthayin: song-level pranaya-sama; verse color = cosmogonic weight (first doctrine-verse of the song; Guru teaching). Firing structures: (a) catalogue drumbeat — four bare nominatives (śaktiḥ māyā prakṛtiḥ pṛthvī) with no verb between them; kept as four stressed beats, commas intact, no ornament on the list itself. (b) weight->division->seal arc: ablative cause (bharat, from-weight), instrumental means (vibhagena, by-division), iti stamp. The em-dash before the seal IS the iti: list, rupture, stamp. (c) prabhuṇa... prabhavitaṃ root-echo (manifestation by the Manifest Lord) -> 'Lord displayed' kept adjacent, let the echo sound in English (Lord/displayed share the d-l skeleton). (d) 'so'->'thus': restores iti exactly (T1 'thus', L0 p009 'thus'); L3's 'so' was looser. Same id, re-grounding. (e) L3 line 1 kept intact — 'From the weight of his own power's glory, the fourfold egg divided:' already processional; fix defects never taste. Dash-pattern note: fourth straight verse hinged on an em-dash — signature so far, not mannerism: each dash does different work (v01 suspension, v02 held whirl, v03 time-fold, v04 seal-stamp). Vary when a verse wants it. Vowel arc: ay/oh weight -> ow/ah names -> long ay close (displayed). Rupture: dash = the stamp. Read aloud: drumbeat, break, seal.
